name: Sokotosuchus
sum: Sokotosuchus is a dyrosaurid crocodyliform from the Maastrichtian Dukamaje Formation of Nigeria, with possible material from Mali.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Fossils from the Dukamaje Formation and possibly Mali.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Halstead 1975
